name: Champaner Heritage Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: The only proper resort near the UNESCO Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park, ~11 km from Champaner Fort, sprawled across 40 acres with mango orchards and the Dev Dam. Multi-cuisine kitchen serves Kathiyawadi, Punjabi, Chinese, and Continental; rated 4.4/5 across 1,900+ Justdial reviews despite mixed Tripadvisor food feedback.
insider_tip: Outdoor lakeside dining is the better setting than the indoor hall — book it for dinner if weather permits. Liquor pricing is reportedly steep; eat here, drink in town.
signature_address: Champaner Heritage Resort, Village Bhamaria, Champaner-Jambughoda Road, Taluka Halol, Panchmahal 389350

name: Hotel Heritage Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the more-reviewed Halol-side options on Tripadvisor — flagged as the better mid-range pick for Gujarati thali in Halol town itself. Useful for travellers without their own transport who can't make it to the heritage resort.
insider_tip: Halol is ~11 km from Pavagadh ropeway base — combine with a morning Pavagadh climb + afternoon thali on the way back. Auto-rickshaws are easy from Halol bus stand.

name: Udan Khatola Pavagadh Ropeway Cafeteria
area: Pavagadh Hill ropeway base / Machi mid-station
signature_dish: Hygienic snack stop on the temple climb
why_it_matters: The ropeway cafeteria is consistently cited as 'the most hygienic food option at Pavagadh' across pilgrim guides — the alternative is informal vendor stalls between Machi and the Mahakali temple, which are calorie-quick but variable on hygiene. Operates within ropeway hours (6 AM-6 PM).
insider_tip: Eat before the climb up from Machi, not after — the temple ridge has only prasad and limited snack stalls. Carry bottled water from the cafeteria for the 250-step temple stretch above the ropeway exit.
signature_address: Pavagadh Ropeway base, Pavagadh Hill, near Mahakali Temple, Panchmahal 389350
